map.最小公倍数是能被一组数同时整除的最小正整数。利用 LCM(a,b)=|a×b|÷: The least common multiple is the smallest positive integer divisible by a set of numbers at once. It is computed as LCM(a,b) = |a×b| ÷ GCD(a,b), and supports several numbers.
map.支持负数取绝对值: Supports absolute value of negative numbers
map.周期事件对齐(如每 3 天与每 4 天重合): Aligning periodic events (for example every 3 days and every 4 days coinciding)
map.多个数可两两求 LCM: For several numbers, find LCM pairwise
map.LCM 不会小于其中最大数: LCM cannot be smaller than the largest of the numbers
map.→ 去使用 最小公倍数（免费 · 纯前端 · 数据不上传）: -> Go use the Least Common Multiple (free · pure front end · data never uploaded)
